lemma x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux1 {α R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (p : MvPolynomial α R) (e : α) : (MvPolynomial.pderiv e p).vars ⊆ p.vars := by
  classical
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ham⟩ := (MvPolynomial.mem_vars_iff_mem_support a).mp ha
  apply (MvPolynomial.mem_vars_iff_mem_support a).mpr
  refine ⟨m + Finsupp.single e 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff] at hm ⊢
    intro h
    exact hm (by simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_pderiv, h])
  · apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr
    have hma := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp ham
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
    omega

lemma x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux2 {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (P : Set α → Prop) (E : Set α) (hP : ∀ I, P I → I ⊆ E) :
    ∀ a ∈ (x2611_15512_set_polynomial P).vars, a ∈ E := by
  classical
  intro a ha
  unfold x2611_15512_set_polynomial at ha
  obtain ⟨A, hA, ha⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp (MvPolynomial.vars_sum_subset _ _ ha)
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp (MvPolynomial.vars_prod _ ha)
  have hab' : a = b := by simpa using hab
  subst a
  exact hP A (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2 hb

lemma x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux3 {α R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : MvPolynomial α R) (e f : α) :
    (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference p e f).vars ⊆ p.vars := by
  classical
  unfold x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
  apply Finset.Subset.trans (MvPolynomial.vars_sub_subset _)
  apply Finset.union_subset
  · apply Finset.Subset.trans (MvPolynomial.vars_mul _ _)
    exact Finset.union_subset (x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux1 p e)
      (x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux1 p f)
  · apply Finset.Subset.trans (MvPolynomial.vars_mul _ _)
    apply Finset.union_subset (Finset.Subset.refl _)
    exact (x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux1 (MvPolynomial.pderiv f p) e).trans
      (x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux1 p f)

lemma x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux4 {α : Type*}
    (p : MvPolynomial α ℝ) (x : α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ m, 0 ≤ MvPolynomial.coeff m p) (hx : ∀ a ∈ p.vars, 0 ≤ x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x p := by
  classical
  rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum p, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro m hm
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_monomial]
  apply mul_nonneg (hp m)
  change 0 ≤ ∏ a ∈ m.support, x a ^ m a
  apply Finset.prod_nonneg
  intro a ha
  exact pow_nonneg (hx a (MvPolynomial.support_subset_vars_of_mem_support hm ha)) _

-- The new combinatorial step: the lower-degree part of the independent-set
-- Rayleigh difference has nonnegative coefficients in rank at most three.
lemma x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux5 {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (M : Matroid α) (hrank : M.eRank ≤ 3) (e f : α) (m : α →₀ ℕ) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.coeff m
      (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.Indep) e f -
       x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f) := by
  sorry

theorem x2611_15512_thm2_2 {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (M : Matroid α)
    (hrank : M.eRank = 3) (e f : α) (he : e ∈ M.E) (hf : f ∈ M.E)
    (hef : e ≠ f) (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
      (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.Indep) e f) := by
  classical
  -- This hole is exactly the already-queued basis-Rayleigh theorem 2.1.
  have hB : 0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
      (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f) := by
    sorry
  have hIvars := x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux2 M.Indep M.E
    (fun I hI => hI.subset_ground)
  have hBvars := x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux2 M.IsBase M.E
    (fun I hI => hI.subset_ground)
  have hR : 0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x
      (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.Indep) e f -
       x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f) := by
    apply x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux4
    · exact x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux5 M (by rw [hrank]) e f
    · intro a ha
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (MvPolynomial.vars_sub_subset _ ha) with ha | ha
      · exact (hx a (hIvars a (x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux3 _ e f ha))).le
      · exact (hx a (hBvars a (x2611_15512_thm2_2_aux3 _ e f ha))).le
  rw [map_sub] at hR
  linarith
